note: Statutory central/local division of each tax line reported in the MOF monthly 全国财政收支情况. Percentages are of the tax as collected. 'mixed' means the reported line bundles items that are split differently, so no single ratio applies. Rules current as of 2026-09; superseded ratios (VAT 75/25 before 2016, securities stamp duty 97/3 before 2016) are not shown.

taxes.note: Local half accrues to the place of payment. 50/50 was a 2-3 year transitional scheme in 2016 and was made permanent in 2019.

60/40 since 2003 (50/50 in 2002). Tax paid by railways, the postal service, the major state banks, the policy banks, PetroChina, Sinopec and offshore oil firms stays 100% central and is outside the split.
Same scheme as the corporate income tax.
Central fixed revenue. The 2019 plan moves some items from the production to the wholesale/retail stage and assigns the resulting increment to local government; the base stays central.

The reported line bundles two different rules: securities transaction stamp duty has been 100% central since 2016 (97/3 before), while all other stamp duty is 100% local. MOF does not split the monthly line, so no single ratio applies.
A residual covering several small taxes on different rules.
